_comment: Galdur Studio palette. Re-read on every resource reload (F3+T when no screen is open): sprites are grayscale and tinted with these colours at render time. Spacings apply the next time a screen is built.
_format: Colours: "#RRGGBB" (opaque) or "#AARRGGBB". An integer is accepted, but if it fits in 24 bits (<= 0xFFFFFF, no alpha) it is read as opaque RRGGBB with a warning: prefer "#RRGGBB".

spacing._comment: Spacings and sizes, in GUI pixels.
